decisions.action: Retain canonical species name, family and authorship. POWO accepts this combination, published Aliso 18:63 (1999). No species-card rename or installation.

Preserve Buchloe as searchable historical alias of the existing Bouteloua species, not a second learner species. POWO notes Govaerts (1996) as an alternative genus treatment; Columbus (1999) expanded Bouteloua to include Buchloe.

decisions.source_name: Sesleria dactyloides Nutt.; Bulbilis dactyloides (Nutt.) Raf.
decisions.action: Sesleria dactyloides (1818) is the basionym; Bulbilis dactyloides (1819) is another homotypic combination. Neither is a separate accepted species.

decisions.source_name: Calanthera dactyloides (Nutt.) Kunth; Casiostega dactyloides (Nutt.) E.Fourn.
decisions.action: Retain as historical same-type combinations only; do not create duplicate cards.

decisions.source_name: Anthephora axilliflora Steud.; Casiostega humilis Rupr. ex Munro
decisions.action: POWO places both names in the same accepted species concept, based on distinct types. Do not infer that any unvouchered photograph under an old name is verified.

decisions.source_name: Bouteloua mutica Griseb. ex E.Fourn.; Casiostega hookeri Rupr. ex E.Fourn.; Melica mexicana Link ex E.Fourn.
decisions.action: POWO lists these as heterotypic synonyms with 'pro syn.' nomenclatural qualification. Preserve that qualification; do not treat them as accepted published combinations or independent learner taxa.

Columbus et al. (1998) recovered non-monophyly of narrowly circumscribed Bouteloua; Columbus (1999) incorporated Buchloe into an expanded Bouteloua. Older sources can legitimately use Buchloe without implying a different species identity.

Accepted name and synonym mapping do not authenticate individual photographs, sex determination, horticultural cultivars, or any purported hybrid. Existing photo/diagnostic holds and existing scientific states remain unchanged. No hybrid parentage is asserted.

conflict_and_hold_summary.historical_genus: Buchloe is homotypic synonym under POWO; some older authorities used it as accepted
conflict_and_hold_summary.hybrid_identity: HOLD / not evaluated at individual level; no specific hybrid claimed
conflict_and_hold_summary.specimen_photo_identity: HOLD / existing photo identity status preserved, no photo review
conflict_and_hold_summary.infraspecific_rank: No new rank assigned; no infraspecific card created
conflict_and_hold_summary.source_internal_inconsistency: 1995 FEIS species header uses Bouteloua dactyloides while one classification table still displays genus Buchloe; treat as historical editorial legacy, not accepted-name reversal.

references.authority: Kinney, Columbus & Friar 2007 reproductive system phylogeny

handoff: No canonical rename or duplicate installation. Historical aliases already partly represented on species card. Preserve scientific holds; separate media worker owns any photo identity review.
